name: Jelly Security
overview: Optional sign-in protection for Jellyfin 12.2. Playback is left alone.
description: Watches sign-in, keeps plugin-owned records, and can slow, pause, or block sign-in traffic when an administrator enables those options. Jellyfin still checks the password.

versions.changelog: First public release. Sign-in defenses (password delay, account cooldown, lockout watch, CAPTCHA, honeypot), 6 pattern detectors, API scan watch with liftable slow-downs, manual and automatic address bans with proxy trust and optional IPv6 /64 prefix bans, session watch, edge proxy snippets (Nginx, Caddy, Cloudflare), geo blocks, webhook alerts, backup/restore with secret redaction, and a live 8-tab dashboard with attack timeline.
